$comment: Public/private classification for every artefact under docs/jtbd/, in the vocabulary of docs/editions/REPOSITORY_BOUNDARY.md §2. `generated` marks a file scripts/jtbd-gate.js writes, so it can be regenerated on either side of the boundary rather than copied. The rule that decides the hard cases is §3: a document goes private because it is COMMERCIAL, never because it is unflattering. Nothing here is executed by this PR — no file moves and no history is rewritten.

docs/jtbd/README.md.why: what the corpus is and what it is not; no commercial content

docs/jtbd/AGENTS.md.why: the evidence discipline an agent must follow; the part of this directory most worth reading in public

docs/jtbd/MASTER.md.why: the rendered corpus, so it carries the same priority scores and differentiation hypotheses as the JSONL
docs/jtbd/MASTER.md.publicHalf: job statements, use cases, acceptance criteria
docs/jtbd/MASTER.md.privateHalf: roadmap scoring and the differentiation hypothesis per job

docs/jtbd/quality_report.md.why: how the corpus was built and checked

docs/jtbd/PORTFOLIO_ALIGNMENT.md.why: the three-layer design; states a boundary rather than a plan

docs/jtbd/catalog/jtbd.jsonl.why: each record holds the desired job (public) beside roadmap.priority, business_value_1_5, strategic_fit_1_5, differentiation_1_5, audit_priority_score_0_100 and competitive_benchmark.accordo_differentiation_hypothesis, which are commercial judgement under §3
docs/jtbd/catalog/jtbd.jsonl.publicHalf: job statement, use case, acceptance criteria, capabilities, NFRs, test obligations
docs/jtbd/catalog/jtbd.jsonl.privateHalf: roadmap scoring fields and the competitive benchmark block
docs/jtbd/catalog/jtbd.jsonl.note: the file is byte-frozen and hash-verified by docs/jtbd/tools/verify_catalog.py, so the split cannot be executed by editing it in place. The public projection is the coverage and roadmap overlays plus a generated public subset; the migration writes that subset before anything moves.

docs/jtbd/catalog/personas.json.why: roles, missions and KPIs; no Accordo commercial position

docs/jtbd/catalog/capabilities.json.why: a capability vocabulary with required evidence per capability

docs/jtbd/coverage/STATUS_CROSSWALK.md.why: how the catalogue enum maps onto the four repository statuses

docs/jtbd/coverage/MATRIX_CROSSWALK.md.why: which desired job each coverage row is a claim about

docs/jtbd/coverage/matrix_crosswalk.json.why: the same, machine-readable; carries no priority

docs/jtbd/coverage/assessments.json.why: evidence and named limitations. §3: never private because it is unflattering, and this file is mostly limitations

docs/jtbd/coverage/coverage.overlay.json.why: the public statement of what this repository proves, generated from assessments.json

docs/jtbd/roadmap/pillars.json.why: pillar, edition, track and milestone names already public in docs/editions/REPOSITORY_BOUNDARY.md §6 and EXECUTION_ROADMAP; no sequencing tied to commercial timing

docs/jtbd/roadmap/capability_pillars.jso.why: a capability-to-pillar table; states ownership, not priority

docs/jtbd/roadmap/roadmap.overlay.jsonl.why: generated ownership; carries no priority, business value or competitive rationale

docs/jtbd/prompts/01_repo_coverage_audit.why: an audit method anyone auditing this repository should be able to read

docs/jtbd/prompts/02_gap_to_roadmap.md.why: the gap analysis is public; the scoring weights that turn a gap into a priority are commercial
docs/jtbd/prompts/02_gap_to_roadmap.md.publicHalf: how a demonstrated gap becomes a candidate

docs/jtbd/prompts/03_jtbd_to_spec.md.why: how a desired job becomes a testable specification

docs/jtbd/prompts/04_competitor_benchmar.why: competitive research, named explicitly by §3 as the commercial case

docs/jtbd/prompts/05_simulate_lifecycle..why: a simulation method, no commercial content

docs/jtbd/schemas/coverage.schema.json.why: the portable assessment shape. Note it is the CATALOGUE's enum, not this repository's four statuses — docs/jtbd/coverage/STATUS_CROSSWALK.md is the bridge

docs/jtbd/tools/verify_catalog.py.why: the integrity check on the frozen corpus

docs/jtbd/tools/query_catalog.py.why: the slice tool; reads the overlays and prints no priority field

docs/jtbd/catalog/supersessions.json.why: Retired public ids must remain resolvable.

docs/jtbd/quality/correction-proposal-v1.why: Record-by-record semantic correction proposal exposes portfolio quality decisions.

docs/jtbd/quality/correction-log-v1.1.js.why: Public provenance for changed desired semantics and checksum.

docs/jtbd/quality/dispositions-v1.1.json.why: Detailed quality disposition backlog is strategic portfolio analysis.

docs/jtbd/roadmap/assignments.jsonl.why: Public status, track, milestone and dependencies stay; private priority and commercial rationale never enter this file.

docs/jtbd/roadmap/override-reviews.json.why: Reviewed technical ownership exceptions use a closed public basis and an existing evidence path; commercial judgement is not accepted.

docs/jtbd/quality/REVERSE_CAPABILITY_AUD.why: Gap and overbuild analysis is strategic portfolio quality evidence.

docs/jtbd/NORMALIZATION_V1_1.md.why: Public correction boundary, limitations and evidence-preservation rules.

docs/jtbd/quality/SEMANTIC_QUALITY_FINDI.why: Detailed semantic defect analysis of the complete strategic portfolio.

docs/jtbd/quality/findings.json.why: Machine semantic findings over the complete strategic portfolio.

docs/jtbd/tools/audit_semantic_quality.p.why: Detector for private strategic portfolio quality analysis.

docs/jtbd/quality/approval-boundary-revi.why: Record-level semantic approval review is strategic portfolio analysis; its public correction log preserves provenance.

docs/jtbd/quality/semantic-review-packet.why: Clustered semantic exceptions and product decisions are strategic portfolio review context.

docs/jtbd/roadmap/assignment-audit-v1.1..why: Machine review of public technical ownership fields without priority or commercial sequencing.

docs/jtbd/tools/reconcile_semantic_revie.why: Reproducibly generates public correction provenance and review artifacts without changing coverage.
